details.detail: Overall massing: shell height 1.30 m, 2.20 m length, the wardrobe on the aisle side, the console on the window side and the screen wall all sit in the right places (s1, s5, q02 vs omaat_f7, f_17314).

Wall-top caps. Every wall carries a 0.085 m sausage bullnose (radius 0.038, 2.5 cm overhang). In the real cabin the wardrobe and aisle-corner caps are squared blocks with small radii (about 0.05-0.06 high, radius about 0.015). The screen wall and aft wall have only a thin rim (omaat_f10, f47, f9, pb_20). This is the most prominent shape error in q02 and q05 and in every studio shot.

Fluted aisle exterior. Rib pitch is 0.022 (pb_20 has about 27 ribs per leaf, so this is OK). The rib frame is light taupe fShell (#69655f), but the photos show the frame as dark as or darker than the ribs: pb_20 frame #423631 against rib #5a4e46, and in f7 the frame matches the ribs (#413924). There is still no closed-door state.

Screen wall. The 43 in screen, the window-side wood wing, the aisle pier with its lamp and pill mirror, and the centre-suite layout are now inside the shell (fixed, see c_screen and q02). The pier is coplanar with the screen, while in f10 and f47 the aisle-side pier and lamp sit on a face angled or stepped toward the seat.

Stowed table and aisle box. Size and height are right (the table is about 0.03 below the screen, as in f10). The table wood fShelf #3a302a is warm brown; the real table is neutral or cool dark grey (f47 #3e383b). The aisle box is plain; the real one has a lid with a black side latch recess (f10, f47).
Ottoman. Position and height are OK. It reads as a cube in c_top and s3, and the fabric renders mauve (q03 #514b4b) where the photo is warm grey (f10 #81716a, f7 #a29c94).

Window console. The ordering and tapered tray are correct. The whole box is flat taupe fConsole. In reality: a taupe fascia band about 0.15 m, below it a near-black body with a storage door and a long floor grille (f7 #1a1a15, grille #0e0f0c), a dark trim line along the top inner edge (up_privacy_wall), and a sculpted top whose tray is a recessed trough. The loose black 'outlets pocket' block on the face does not exist on the real console, where the outlets are inside the bin (f16, pb_32).
Keypad and handset. The tilted keypad #8a8882 matches up_privacy_wall #898781. The handset in its dock, aft of the keypad, is correct.

Centre divider, raised. It has a thin taupe rail with a tab and stiles near both ends (matches up_privacy_wall and f_17314). The wood is too dark in the cabin (q02 #201a18 against the photo's #433836). There is no lowered state, although omaat_f1 and f5 both show it lowered.

Seat. Width 0.66 and flap width 0.48 match f5 (0.63 and 0.49). The back is too short and too reclined: its top is at about 1.07 m at 11 deg, while f5 measures about 1.20 m at about 5 deg. The flap reads as a dark glass panel (s4 #474a48, darker than the back); the real flap is lighter and cooler than the back (f9 flap #92938e vs back #7d766e; f1 #5b5b57 vs #49403e). The seat fabric is slightly pink.

Aft wall. It is a flat 6 cm panel with two domes. In reality the seat back sits in a sculpted taupe surround: side jambs about 0.14 wide, a header about 0.10, and the domes in the header corners (f5, f9, f1 #786d5c-#928471).
Inner face of the wardrobe. It has dark veneer, a framed safety-card door, a taupe box armrest and a literature pocket, all broadly as in f1, f5 and f9 (wood #291e14-#4b3c2b).

Bed. The pad, duvet and white plus lavender pillows are correct. The QA r3 'wrinkles' are straight half-cylinders that read as grey rods in q04. The real sheet (f47) drapes over the pad edges and has soft, irregular folds and a faint stripe.
Pillow. The colour is in the right family; the model is slightly dark (studio #5f559f against the photos' #a194e2 and #ae9ae0, where the pillow is about 1.3x brighter than the seat fabric).
Seat plaque. It is now smaller and in the right place. The text is white, but on the real plaque it is lit blue or violet (f7 and f9 '2K').

issues.problem: The sausage bullnose caps on every wall top make the whole product look toy-like
issues.detail: cap() = gRBox(cw+0.05, 0.085, cd+0.05, 0.038, 3). It is used on the aft wall, the screen wall, the wardrobe and the aisle corner. The real screen wall and aft wall have a thin rim. The wardrobe and corner caps are squared, flat-topped blocks with small radii, flush with the aisle-side frame.
issues.evidence: q05_suiteBehind.png (the aft-wall roll fills the lower third), q02, s1/s3/s6. omaat_f10/f47: the screen-wall top is about a 0.02 rim. omaat_f7/pb_20: the wardrobe cap is squared, #a08f72 (f7).
issues.fix: In suiteUnit: cap = (cw,cd,x,y,z) => B.add(gRBox(cw+0.012, 0.055, cd+0.012, 0.014, 2), M4.trs(x, y+0.0275, z), SEATMAT.fCap). For the aft wall (z -0.07) and the screen wall (z -L+0.06), use a rim instead: gRBox(w+0.004, 0.022, depth+0.004, 0.008, 1) at y H+0.011. Keep the full cap only on the wardrobe (hx-0.08) and the aisle corner (hx-0.02). Update the suite plaque height in 09_seats.js (1.30+0.0625 -> 1.30+0.055) in the same commit (shared file, one line).

issues.problem: The inner face of the window console is uniform light taupe; the real one is a taupe fascia over a near-black body
issues.detail: There is one gRBox(shelfW, 0.64, L-0.30) in fConsole (#7a736c). The photos show a taupe upper band of about 0.15 m, then a near-black lower body with a storage-bin door line and a long black floor grille. This is a large surface in q03, q04 and w_console.
issues.evidence: omaat_f7: face #1a1a15, grille #0e0f0c, fascia #312d22. up_privacy_wall: fascia #585250 over a dark storage zone. Model q04 console face #4e4a46.
issues.fix: Split the console box: upper gRBox(shelfW, 0.16, L-0.30, 0.02,1) at y 0.56 in fConsole; lower gRBox(shelfW-0.01, 0.48, L-0.30, 0.01,1) at y 0.24, x xo+shelfW/2-0.005, in a new SEATMAT.fConsoleLow {c:'#2b2824', r:0.55} (Object.assign at the top of 09d_suite.js). Enlarge the grille gBox to (0.004, 0.12, 1.2) at y 0.10, colour #121210. Add a bin-door seam gBox(0.003, 0.004, 0.9) at y 0.45. Add a dark trim line gBox(0.004, 0.012, L-0.30) at x xo+shelfW+0.002, y 0.64, colour #3b2f26. Delete the black 'outlets pocket' gRBox at (xo+shelfW+0.001, 0.58, -1.05).

issues.problem: The seat back is too short and too reclined, and there is no sculpted aft surround
issues.detail: BH = trs(0,0.42,-0.10, 11deg) with a 0.665 tall loft puts the top at about 1.07 m. f5 (near-level view, 1.30 wall = 600 px) gives the back top at about 1.20 m, nearly upright. The aft wall is flat; the real seat back sits in a taupe niche with about 0.14 jambs and a 0.10 header, with the domes in the header corners.
issues.evidence: omaat_f5: frame top 140 px, back top 185 px, floor 740 px, giving 1.20 m. omaat_f9 and f1: the niche frame is #786d5c-#928471. s4_suiteW_seat shows a flat wall with the back floating in front of it.
issues.fix: BH: recline 11 -> 5 deg; extend the back loft sections to y 0.78 (SEC(0.755,0.66,...), SEC(0.78,0.64,...)); move the flap to BH y 0.66. Add the niche in suiteUnit: jambs for s of [-1,1]: B.add(gRBox(0.10, H-0.66, 0.12, 0.025, 2), M4.trs(seatX+s*0.38, 0.66+(H-0.66)/2, -0.16), SEATMAT.fShell); header gRBox(0.86, 0.10, 0.12, 0.025, 2) at (seatX, H-0.05, -0.16). Move the lamp domes to (seatX±0.33, H-0.10, -0.222), facing +z.

issues.problem: The headrest flap reads as dark glass, not a light slate vinyl pad
issues.detail: fFlap #666864 with r 0.45 renders #474a48 in s4, darker than the back (#484243), with a specular sheen. The real flap is about 15-20 % lighter and cooler than the back fabric.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9: flap #92938e vs back #7d766e. omaat_f1: #5b5b57 vs #49403e. omaat_f5: #818075 vs #695b52.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): fFlap: {c:'#7e8385', r:0.7, l: LAYER.leather}. In suiteUnit, delete the small black fLeather tab at BH (0.04, 0.455); no tab appears in f9 or f5.

issues.problem: The rib frames of the aisle door panels are light taupe; the real frames are as dark as the ribs
issues.detail: The frame gRBoxes around the rib fields use SEATMAT.fShell, which makes a light picture frame around dark ribs (s1, s6). In reality the whole leaf reads as a uniform dark grey-brown, below the lighter cap.
issues.evidence: pb_20: frame #423631, rib #5a4e46. omaat_f7: ribs #413924, cap #a08f72.
issues.fix: In the exterior loop, change the four frame gRBoxes from SEATMAT.fShell to a new fDoorFrame {c:'#524a40', r:0.5, l:LAYER.plastic}. Optionally darken fFlute toward #544b40.

issues.problem: No lowered state for the centre divider
issues.detail: The divider is always at full height 1.30. Most real photos of the centre pair (omaat_f1, f5, tlfl_21) show it lowered to the console top (about 0.66).
issues.evidence: omaat_f1.jpg and omaat_f5.jpg: lowered. up_privacy_wall: raised.
issues.fix: Add opts.divider (0..1). The wood face and top rail y = 0.66 + divider*(H-0.66). The q02 view of 2D/2G should show it lowered, as in f5.

issues.problem: The table and tray wood is warm brown; the real wood is neutral or cool dark grey
The duvet wrinkles are straight rods
issues.detail: Three gCyl half-rods at seatX+0.03 show as thin grey lines in q04.
issues.evidence: q04_suite1Abed.png vs omaat_f47 (soft irregular folds, sheet draped over the pad edge, #e6cdb0 warm white under cabin light).
issues.fix: Remove the gCyl wrinkles. Instead, widen the duvet loft to 0.76 so it overhangs the pad by 3 cm and drops 4 cm at the sides (a cushionSecs edge of 0.06), and add 2-3 very low (0.008) broad lofted ridges (0.15 wide, crown 0.006) at slight angles.

issues.problem: The ottoman and seat fabric has a mauve cast
issues.detail: fFabric #6a6362 has r-g=7 and g-b=1, so it reads pink-grey.
issues.evidence: omaat_f9 cushion #756c66; f10 ottoman #81716a; q03 ottoman #514b4b.

issues.problem: The seat plaque text is white; the real text is lit blue or violet
issues.evidence: omaat_f7 and omaat_f9 '2K' on a dark tile (mean #726579 including the tile).
issues.fix: 09_seats.js: for suite tags only, tagGlow colour '#8f9cff'.

issues.detail: The doors are always parked open.
issues.fix: Add opts.doors closed: two fluted leaves covering z [-L+0.38, -0.96] at hx+0.002, meeting at the centre, with a chrome double pull (0.03 x 0.09) at y 0.60.

questionsForUser: Should the centre-suite divider default to lowered (as in most in-flight photos, omaat_f1/f5) or raised (up_privacy_wall)?
Is it acceptable to replace the round bullnose caps with squared caps and thin rims? That changes the look of every aisle view.
Is there an authoritative width for the centre suites 1D/1G versus the window suites? The current 1.10 m vs 1.24 m is still derived, not verified.
